CustomField.description: How ApproverValue__c is interpreted. User = the value is a Salesforce username. Queue = the value is a queue developer name. RelatedUser = the value is a field API name on the record being approved whose value is read at runtime as the approver ID. Required when ApproverSource__c = Configured.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave blank when ApproverSource__c is Dynamic or UserInput. For RelatedUser, the field must hold a User ID (e.g. OwnerId, CreatedById, or a custom lookup to User). Cross-object field paths are not supported.
CustomField.label: Approver Type
